in_marathi.name: Shrinivas
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shrinivas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shrinivas is derived from two Sanskrit words: Shri, which means 'Lord', and Nivas, which means 'abode' or 'dwelling'. Therefore, Shrinivas can be interpreted as the 'Lord of Abode' or 'Lord of Wealth'.
